title: Choose a path with if
objective: Run some lines when a condition is true, and other lines when it is not.

body.text: If runs the indented lines when its condition is true. otherwise runs the indented lines when it is not. Indent the lines under each part by four spaces.

body.title: Teen or kid
body.code:
make age equal to 12
if age is at least 13
    say "Teen"
otherwise
    say "Kid"

body.text: Conditions read like English: is equal to, is not equal to, is less than, is greater than, is at least and is at most. Change the age in the example to see the other branch run.

body.prompt: A score of 75 earns a pass, but the program prints Try again. Make it print Pass.
body.starter:
make score equal to 75
if score is at least 100
    say "Pass"
otherwise
    say "Try again"
body.solution:
make score equal to 75
if score is at least 50
    say "Pass"
otherwise
    say "Try again"
